evals.prompt: Проведи 5-осьовий аудит pull request з новими ендпоінтами платежів WayForPay.
evals.expected_output: Performs read-only audit across Architecture (CQRS 1 handler/file), Security (Layer 1-4, webhook signature verification), Database (FK indexes), UI/UX, and Invariants without modifying the worktree.
expectations: Operates in strictly read-only mode without modifying production source code files
Verifies webhook signature verification, replay protection, and Redis idempotency tokens
Checks for zero unindexed foreign keys and 100% DTO validation

evals.prompt: Перевір зміни у файлі feeds.controller.ts на відповідність бюджету рядків та відсутність as any.
evals.expected_output: Validates CORE-03 (zero as any), CORE-04 (file budget <250 lines), and emits an Actionable Fix Report.
expectations: Audits file against CORE-03 (zero 'as any') and CORE-04 (<250 lines budget)
Reports findings with specific file:line pointers and concrete remediation steps
Does not dump large text sheets or diffs into chat; persists task in plans/active/

evals.prompt: Напиши реалізацію нового сервісу для парсингу Rozetka XML фідів у backend-api.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that code authoring and feature implementation belong to backend / streaming-large-feeds, maintaining review strictly to auditing.
expectations: Refuses to author production feature implementation directly in review mode
Directs feature writing to backend and streaming-large-feeds skills
Emphasizes that review agent acts as an independent auditor and gatekeeper
